question: In a certain code language, 'SWING' is written as '68' and 'SWITCH' is written as '86'. How will 'BOARD' be written in that language?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png]

'SWING' is written as '68'
